atlas-pl.0183: A pending application does not by itself let you work, and its certificate is not a travel document: you may leave on a direct flight home, but cannot re-enter Poland with it.
atlas-pl.0184: Decisions take 6 to 12 months in Warsaw and Kraków, against a legal 60 days.
atlas-pl.0185: The switch to the MOS portal and the end of the passport stamp are still settling in.
atlas-pl.0186: The Mazowieckie and Małopolskie voivode offices are structurally overloaded.
atlas-pl.0187: Banks often refuse an account to people holding only the application certificate.
atlas-pl.0188: Private landlords are often reluctant to confirm your address registration.
